## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated, and `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes
- [ ] The release build works: `./gradlew assembleRelease`
- [ ] No new network calls, logging of personal data, or secrets
- [ ] New text is in `strings.xml` (with plurals where needed) and translated, or the missing languages are noted
- [ ] Database changes include a migration, the new schema file and a migration test
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
